name: HardGuard25
description: A 25-character alphabet for identifiers that humans read, type, print, scan, or say aloud.
fit_signals: People manually read, type, print, scan, copy, or dictate identifiers.
The identifier design should exclude common visual confusables.
The implementation can choose a payload length appropriate to its collision risk.
A lightweight optional check digit would help detect common entry errors.
not_a_fit: Cryptographic keys, passwords, authentication secrets, or encryption material.
Systems requiring a global UUID, distributed coordination, or time ordering protocol.
Machine-only identifiers where human readability is irrelevant.
A claim of empirically proven OCR or transcription superiority.

tasks.description: Decide whether HardGuard25 is appropriate for a human-facing identifier workflow.
Add generation, normalization, validation, and optional check-digit verification to an existing project.
Read the normative alphabet, normalization contract, collision guidance, checksum, and conformance requirements.
Generate example identifiers locally in the browser without a hosted execution API.

execution.note: The interactive generator runs in the browser. Package adoption occurs in the user's own project.
